brief.last: Reply is filed. The appellant seeks time for rejoinder. Interim order to continue.

cases.title: Kaveri Polymers v. Pollution Control Committee

brief.about: The appeal challenges a closure direction dated 06.01.2025 issued on the ground that the appellant's effluent treatment plant was found non-functional. The appellant says the plant was under scheduled maintenance for 48 hours.

brief.last: Arguments of both sides heard at length. The appellant relied on the circular dated 18.11.2021 extending time for filing. The respondent says the circular applies only prospectively.

brief.about: The appellant disputes reassessment of property tax for House No. 1182 treating the first floor as let out. He says his son occupies it.
